fields.Brand Customer Promise: Flexible extended-stay accommodations with in-room kitchen capability and Choice’s extended-stay expertise—supported by conversion-friendly prototypes that help owners meet growing longer-stay demand.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Practical longer-stay lodging with kitchen-in-a-box solutions and communal space adaptations suited to extended visits.

Owners: Rebrand and repositioning within Choice’s extended-stay platform, proprietary kitchen-in-a-box entry point, and access to dedicated extended-stay sales, operations, and marketing programs.

Choice: Part of a coordinated extended-stay portfolio (WoodSpring, MainStay, Everhome, Suburban) with 70+ experts and 800+ properties open or under development (corporate materials).
fields.Brand Pillars:
Extended-stay focus — designed for guests who stay longer than traditional nightly travelers.

Conversion enablement — kitchen-in-a-box and lobby adaptations for upgrading select nightly hotels.

Choice extended-stay network — shared expertise, suppliers, and national sales across the portfolio.

Value and simplicity — midscale extended-stay positioning within the Choice family.
fields.Brand History: Suburban Studios was rebranded within Choice Hotels’ extended-stay strategy, alongside the introduction of proprietary kitchen-in-a-box solutions to provide an accessible entry point to extended-stay conversions and operations (Choice extended-stay development materials).
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Cost- and convenience-minded travelers who need residential functionality for weeks-long work, relocation, or personal transitions—aligned with Choice’s broader extended-stay guest profiles.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Rebranded extended-stay offer within Choice’s portfolio with kitchen-in-a-box conversion support.

Shared extended-stay infrastructure with MainStay, WoodSpring, and Everhome.

Focus on length-of-stay economics vs. traditional nightly operations.
